checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is isinstance check order in encode_receipt properly ordered to prevent class hierarchy ambiguity for SetCodeTransaction?

reachability.notes: Attacker submits a SetCodeTransaction. If isinstance(tx, FeeMarketTransaction) matches first due to inheritance, the receipt gets prefix 0x02 instead of 0x04, causing receipt root divergence.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the encode_receipt function and locate all isinstance checks for transaction types. 2. Map the class inheritance hierarchy of all transaction types (SetCodeTransaction, FeeMarketTransaction, AccessListTransaction, LegacyTransaction, etc.). 3. Verify that isinstance checks are ordered from most-specific subclass to least-specific parent class. 4. Construct a test SetCodeTransaction and trace through the isinstance dispatch logic to confirm it matches SetCodeTransaction before any parent class. 5. If misordered, craft a PoC transaction that triggers the wrong branch and verify the incorrect receipt prefix (0x02 instead of 0x04). 6. Compute the receipt root with the incorrect prefix and compare against expected receipt root to demonstrate divergence.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0007, Trust Boundary: tb-007, Threat: stride-016. A consensus-critical bug where incorrect isinstance ordering causes wrong receipt encoding, leading to receipt root mismatch and network-wide consensus split.

checklist.title: Verify Execution Engine handles SetCodeTransaction type dispatch correctly without class hierarchy ambiguity

reachability.notes: Attacker submits a SetCodeTransaction. If isinstance(tx, FeeMarketTransaction) matches first due to inheritance, the receipt gets prefix 0x02 instead of 0x04, causing receipt root divergence.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the execution engine's transaction processing flow (actor-execution-engine node). 2. Identify all code paths where transaction type determines behavior (receipt encoding, gas calculation, signature verification). 3. For each isinstance/type-check dispatch, verify the check order respects the class hierarchy. 4. Create unit tests with SetCodeTransaction instances and assert they are correctly identified as SetCodeTransaction, not misidentified as FeeMarketTransaction or other parent types. 5. Verify receipt prefix is 0x04 for SetCodeTransaction, not 0x02.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0007, Supporting Node: actor-execution-engine. This check verifies the internal execution engine correctly handles the transaction type dispatch that supports the boundary security.
